distillation_scope.disease_name_only_prompt: ARDS / 急性呼吸窮迫症候群
distillation_scope.leaf_granularity: Pure first-layer disease leaf for acute respiratory distress syndrome across direct and indirect triggers.
distillation_scope.boundary_policy: COVID-19, sepsis, aspiration, pneumonia, trauma, transfusion, pancreatitis, inhalational injury, obstetric microangiopathy, and postoperative states are trigger/context axes or future comorbid manifolds; they are not disease-id qualifiers.

latent_mechanisms.clinical_meaning: Diffuse injury to alveolar epithelial and capillary endothelial barriers initiates permeability edema, inflammatory cell influx, and impaired gas exchange.

latent_mechanisms.display_name_ja: 透過性亢進性非心原性肺水腫
latent_mechanisms.clinical_meaning: Increased alveolar-capillary permeability moves protein-rich fluid into interstitium and alveoli without primary left atrial hypertension.

latent_mechanisms.display_name_ja: サーファクタント機能低下と無気肺
latent_mechanisms.clinical_meaning: Proteinaceous edema and epithelial injury impair surfactant, increase alveolar collapse, and make oxygenation dependent on recruitment and PEEP.

latent_mechanisms.display_name_ja: 好中球・サイトカイン性肺炎症
latent_mechanisms.clinical_meaning: Neutrophil recruitment, cytokine release, protease injury, and oxidative stress amplify pulmonary permeability and systemic inflammatory spillover.

latent_mechanisms.display_name_ja: シャント・換気血流不均等性低酸素血症
latent_mechanisms.clinical_meaning: Flooded and collapsed lung units create shunt and severe V/Q mismatch, causing low PaO2/FiO2 and oxygen saturation despite high inspired oxygen.

latent_mechanisms.display_name_ja: 低コンプライアンスと機械的ストレス
latent_mechanisms.clinical_meaning: Reduced aerated lung volume creates a small baby-lung compartment vulnerable to high driving pressure, volutrauma, atelectrauma, and barotrauma.

latent_mechanisms.display_name_ja: 肺血管抵抗上昇と右心負荷
latent_mechanisms.clinical_meaning: Hypoxic vasoconstriction, microthrombi, hypercapnia, and high airway pressures can raise pulmonary vascular resistance and right ventricular afterload.
Persistent epithelial injury and inflammatory repair can progress to fibroproliferation, prolonged ventilation, low compliance, and delayed recovery.

mechanism_edges.rationale: Barrier injury drives permeability edema.
Damaged alveolar-capillary units recruit inflammatory cells.
Protein-rich edema inactivates surfactant and promotes derecruitment.
Flooded lung units create shunt physiology.
Atelectatic units worsen V/Q mismatch.
Loss of aerated lung lowers compliance.
Hypoxic pulmonary vasoconstriction and high ventilatory pressures increase RV load.
Persistent inflammation promotes fibroproliferative repair.
Diffuse lung injury manifests as acute hypoxemic failure.
Worse shunt physiology increases respiratory failure severity.
ARDS severity is reflected by a low PaO2/FiO2 ratio.
Shunt and V/Q mismatch lower arterial saturation.
Gas exchange impairment lowers PaO2.
Hypoxemia drives oxygen support need.
More severe hypoxemia requires more oxygen or ventilatory support.
Clinicians increase FiO2 to maintain oxygenation.
Permeability edema is central to ARDS.
Greater leak produces more radiographic edema.
Alveolar edema and collapse produce pulmonary opacities.
Typical ARDS affects both lungs with bilateral opacities.
More permeability edema increases bilateral opacity extent.
Edema and diffuse alveolar damage often appear as ground-glass opacity.
Reduced aerated lung volume lowers respiratory system compliance.
Stiff lungs generate high plateau pressure at a given tidal volume.
Low compliance raises driving pressure unless tidal volume is reduced.
Severe ARDS commonly needs positive-pressure support.
Invasive ventilation is often needed when work of breathing or oxygenation cannot be supported noninvasively.
PEEP is raised to recruit unstable alveoli.
Stiff, heterogeneously aerated lung exposed to positive pressure is vulnerable to air leak.
High stress and strain increase VILI risk.
Protective ventilation and dead-space ventilation can produce hypercapnia.
Severe stiffness and protective settings may cause CO2 retention.
Higher PaCO2 marks more severe ventilatory limitation.
Pulmonary vascular load can precipitate RV failure.
RV strain and systemic critical illness can coexist with shock.
Shock physiology often requires vasopressors.
Very low P/F despite high FiO2 and PEEP defines refractory oxygenation risk.
Fibroproliferation delays liberation from ventilation.
Systemic inflammation often raises CRP when the trigger is inflammatory.
Fever may reflect the trigger or sterile inflammatory lung injury.
Sterile or infectious ARDS triggers can produce systemic neutrophilic leukocytosis.
Alveolar flooding and atelectatic lung units can produce crackles on examination.
Severe hypoxemia can manifest as cyanosis.
Atelectasis and poorly aerated dependent lung can reduce breath sounds.
ARDS can produce dependent consolidation from alveolar flooding and collapse.
Severe oxygenation failure is a major mortality driver.
Low compliance and high mechanical stress predict worse outcomes.
RV failure and shock worsen survival.
Nonresolving fibroproliferative ARDS increases late mortality.

mechanism_edges.clinical_rationale: Hypoxemia is the parent finding for low oxygen saturation; the raw SpO2 measurement remains separate.

axes.clinical_interpretation: Presence of clinically significant hypoxemia; oxygen saturation remains the raw measurement.
Observed inhalational chemical exposure as an ARDS trigger/context, not a disease label.
Probability that chlorine gas exposure is present as a direct lung-injury trigger.

axis_couplings.clinical_rationale: Lower PaO2/FiO2 raises refractory hypoxemia event risk.
Low saturation despite support indicates immediate oxygenation hazard.
PEEP can recruit alveoli and improve oxygenation when recruitable lung exists.
Higher PEEP can increase air-leak risk when combined with high pressures or heterogeneous lung.
High plateau pressure increases mechanical stress.
Driving pressure captures strain per aerated lung compartment.
Lower compliance increases airway pressure for a given tidal volume.
Hypercapnia can increase pulmonary vascular resistance.
Shock and vasopressor need increase ARDS mortality.
Persistent refractory hypoxemia is a proximal mortality pathway.
Pneumothorax or pneumomediastinum can acutely destabilize severe ARDS.
Secondary ventilator-associated infection worsens late ARDS outcomes.
Longer ventilation increases exposure time for ventilator-associated infection.

effect_modifiers.clinical_rationale: Severe acidemia may limit permissive hypercapnia tolerance.
Very low compliance increases the value of lowering stress and strain.
High intrathoracic pressure can impair venous return in unstable shock.
Recruitable collapsed units are more likely to improve with PEEP.
High pressures and fragile lung increase air-leak risk.
Unstable spine, open abdomen, or unsafe lines can limit proning.
Profound instability can delay or interrupt proning sessions.

treatments.display_name_ja: 人工呼吸同調目的の筋弛緩

effect_modifiers.clinical_rationale: Neuromuscular disease, prolonged paralysis risk, or inability to monitor sedation changes utility.
Deep sedation and paralysis can worsen hemodynamic support needs.
Fluid restriction or removal before perfusion stabilization can worsen shock.
Diuresis or fluid removal requires renal and perfusion monitoring.

treatments.display_name_ja: 吸入肺血管拡張薬レスキュー

effect_modifiers.clinical_rationale: Benefit is most likely when pulmonary vascular mismatch or RV strain is prominent.
Transient oxygenation rescue has less utility without severe hypoxemia.
Irreversible comorbidity, prolonged injurious ventilation, or resource constraints reduce expected benefit.
VV-ECMO usually requires anticoagulation and cannulation risk management.
ECMO is a rescue therapy when conventional support cannot maintain gas exchange.

treatments.display_name_ja: 誘因制御・原因別治療

effect_modifiers.clinical_rationale: Delayed control of the initiating insult allows established diffuse alveolar damage and fibroproliferation.

supportive_care: 低酸素血症、P/F比、SpO2、FiO2、PEEP、プラトー圧、駆動圧、換気量を継続評価する
酸素投与、HFNC、NIV、挿管人工呼吸を呼吸仕事量と酸素化に応じて調整する
肺保護換気では低一回換気量、プラトー圧抑制、駆動圧抑制を狙う
PEEPは酸素化改善と過膨張、血行動態、圧外傷リスクを同時に見て調整する
腹臥位は低P/Fで換気中の患者に対し実施可能性と安全性を確認して検討する
人工呼吸同調不良や強い自発努力では鎮静、鎮痛、短期筋弛緩の文脈を評価する
ショックが安定した後は水分バランスを保守的に管理し肺水腫の遷延を避ける
感染、吸引、輸血反応、膵炎、外傷、薬剤、吸入曝露など誘因を同時に評価し制御する
難治性低酸素血症では吸入肺血管拡張薬、リクルートメント、VV-ECMO文脈を評価する
圧外傷、右心不全、人工呼吸器関連肺炎、急性腎障害をイベントハザードとして追跡する
栄養、血栓予防、ストレス潰瘍予防、せん妄予防、早期リハビリをICU文脈で調整する
